name: Mare Ashley-Pecker
original_name: メア・アシュリーペッカー
source:
"This ore deposit within the cave... is all interlinked deep underground, as a single Dying Will."

- Origin: Guf Confederation
- Birthday: March 4
- Height: 144 cm
- Three Size: B70(A)/W54/H60
- Likes: Fried chicken, friends
- Dislikes: Gesellmann
- Will/Gem: "Chains of Love, Courage and Wisdom" Santa Maria Aquamarine Endless Chain

A gifted Therion who was freed from the unescapable shackles of her past.
After a one-year period when everyone was her favorite, she has been regaining her original stinginess recently.
